The payment term code (cCodParc) of a service order in Omie. It is not a preference: it tells Omie whether the installments come from a registered payment condition or from the request itself.

Fields

CustomInstallments

Installments defined by the integrator (999) — the only code under which Omie accepts the Parcelas structure. Any service order that sends an explicit installment must use this code.

Sending another code alongside the installments passes IncluirOS — Omie stores the order already with 999 — but AlterarOS refuses it: "A estrutura de parcelas [Parcelas] está disponível apenas para o Código de Parcelamento [cCodParc=999]!". An order included that way only fails on its first change, much later. 

public const string CustomInstallments = "999"
